meta.title: Moon and Starshine Intertwined
meta.description: The Oasis has never had starless nights.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Observatory.

units.rawText: Huff... huff... Never thought that the observatory would be this high up...

spans.text: Huff... huff... Never thought that the observatory would be this high up...

units.displayText: Luna stands atop the observatory's roof, looking upwards.

units.rawText: Doesn't seem to be a lot of stars today...
units.displayText: Doesn't seem to be a lot of stars today...

spans.text: Doesn't seem to be a lot of stars today...

units.rawText: According to the signs... I've picked out a most fitting outfit, with accessories to match... and the portents of the day of the event have been revealed as well.

units.displayText: Luna slaps herself lightly, as if pumping herself up.

spans.text: Luna slaps herself lightly, as if pumping herself up.

units.rawText: Get it together, Luna! Can't let this go down like the first time you told a fortune here...
units.displayText: Get it together, Luna! Can't let this go down like the first time you told a fortune here...

spans.text: Get it together, Luna! Can't let this go down like the first time you told a fortune here...

units.displayText: Luna surveys her surroundings, her gaze sweeping across every corner of the observatory before finally meeting my eyes.

spans.text: Luna surveys her surroundings, her gaze sweeping across every corner of the observatory before finally meeting my eyes.

units.rawText: Ehhhh?! P-Professor? Why are you here?
units.displayText: Ehhhh?! P-Professor? Why are you here?

spans.text: Ehhhh?! P-Professor? Why are you here?

units.rawText: I just happened to have some business here...
units.displayText: I just happened to have some business here...

spans.text: I just happened to have some business here...

units.rawText: Before I could finish my response, the lights in the observatory began to extinguish one by one.
units.displayText: Before I could finish my response, the lights in the observatory began to extinguish one by one.

spans.text: Before I could finish my response, the lights in the observatory began to extinguish one by one.

units.rawText: Welcome, both of you, to the observatory. The night sky's performance is about to begin.
units.displayText: Welcome, both of you, to the observatory. The night sky's performance is about to begin.

spans.text: Welcome, both of you, to the observatory. The night sky's performance is about to begin.

units.rawText: Huh? What do you...
units.displayText: Huh? What do you...

spans.text: Huh? What do you...

units.displayText: We follow the source of the voice as a star trails across the sky.

spans.text: We follow the source of the voice as a star trails across the sky.

units.rawText: A shooting star...
units.displayText: A shooting star...

spans.text: A shooting star...

units.rawText: One, two, three... as if choreographed, the stars ignite one by one, creating a breathtaking spectacle.
units.displayText: One, two, three... as if choreographed, the stars ignite one by one, creating a breathtaking spectacle.

spans.text: One, two, three... as if choreographed, the stars ignite one by one, creating a breathtaking spectacle.

units.rawText: We admire the exquisite sight until the last star fades away.
units.displayText: We admire the exquisite sight until the last star fades away.

spans.text: We admire the exquisite sight until the last star fades away.

units.rawText: Was that display of the stars I prepared to your liking?
units.displayText: Was that display of the stars I prepared to your liking?

spans.text: Was that display of the stars I prepared to your liking?

units.rawText: As the shooting stars gracefully fade into the horizon, Hubble emerges, taking a deep bow.
units.displayText: As the shooting stars gracefully fade into the horizon, Hubble emerges, taking a deep bow.

spans.text: As the shooting stars gracefully fade into the horizon, Hubble emerges, taking a deep bow.

options.rawText: Never imagined that the introduction ceremony would be this grand.
options.displayText: Never imagined that the introduction ceremony would be this grand.

spans.text: Never imagined that the introduction ceremony would be this grand.

options.rawText: I hope those stars won't leave any meteorite craters.
options.displayText: I hope those stars won't leave any meteorite craters.

spans.text: I hope those stars won't leave any meteorite craters.

units.rawText: Hehe, as long as you like it, Professor. What do you think, Luna?

spans.text: Hehe, as long as you like it, Professor. What do you think, Luna?

units.rawText: Hehe, rest easy, Professor. They are nothing more than projections, with no real mass. What do you think, Luna?
units.displayText: Hehe, rest easy, Professor. They are nothing more than projections, with no real mass. What do you think, Luna?

spans.text: Hehe, rest easy, Professor. They are nothing more than projections, with no real mass. What do you think, Luna?

units.rawText: They were spectacular! It's the first time I've seen so many shooting stars.
units.displayText: They were spectacular! It's the first time I've seen so many shooting stars.

spans.text: They were spectacular! It's the first time I've seen so many shooting stars.

units.rawText: Did you specifically arrange these, Hubble? The timing seems somewhat uncanny...
units.displayText: Did you specifically arrange these, Hubble? The timing seems somewhat uncanny...

spans.text: Did you specifically arrange these, Hubble? The timing seems somewhat uncanny...

units.rawText: The stars gave me their answer.
units.displayText: The stars gave me their answer.

spans.text: The stars gave me their answer.

units.rawText: Eh? Could it be that you are adept at fortune-telling as well, Hubble? Now that I think about it, astrology and fortune telling are intrinsically intertwined...
units.displayText: Eh? Could it be that you are adept at fortune-telling as well, Hubble? Now that I think about it, astrology and fortune telling are intrinsically intertwined...

spans.text: Eh? Could it be that you are adept at fortune-telling as well, Hubble? Now that I think about it, astrology and fortune telling are intrinsically intertwined...

units.rawText: Hehe, you're looking at the Holographic Star Projector Fresnel and I made.
units.displayText: Hehe, you're looking at the Holographic Star Projector Fresnel and I made.

spans.text: Hehe, you're looking at the Holographic Star Projector Fresnel and I made.

units.displayText: Hubble presents a small object in her hand that emits streams of light, converging to form stars in the skies above.

units.rawText: The stars in the sky begin to move and realign themselves, and the flickering star soon finds its proper place in the constellation.
units.displayText: The stars in the sky begin to move and realign themselves, and the flickering star soon finds its proper place in the constellation.

units.displayText: The stars exert their mutual gravitational pull, maintaining the system's stability.

units.rawText: Even if the forces are thrown out of balance for a moment, the stars will adjust and pull each other into new orbits.
units.displayText: Even if the forces are thrown out of balance for a moment, the stars will adjust and pull each other into new orbits.

options.rawText: Just like us at the Oasis.
options.displayText: Just like us at the Oasis.

units.rawText: Hehe, you must be the great star at the center of it all, then.

units.rawText: Hehe, so that's what's going on... let's test it out!
units.displayText: Hehe, so that's what's going on... let's test it out!

spans.text: Hehe, so that's what's going on... let's test it out!

units.rawText: Professor, Professor! Do our outfits live up to your expectations for what you envisioned for the anniversary?
units.displayText: Professor, Professor! Do our outfits live up to your expectations for what you envisioned for the anniversary?

spans.text: Professor, Professor! Do our outfits live up to your expectations for what you envisioned for the anniversary?

units.rawText: The pair, adorned in their extraordinary apparel, captivate my gaze, their elegance undiminished even by the splendor of the night sky, like a living constellation of moon and stars.
units.displayText: The pair, adorned in their extraordinary apparel, captivate my gaze, their elegance undiminished even by the splendor of the night sky, like a living constellation of moon and stars.

spans.text: The pair, adorned in their extraordinary apparel, captivate my gaze, their elegance undiminished even by the splendor of the night sky, like a living constellation of moon and stars.

units.rawText: Yeah, fits you two perfectly.
units.displayText: Yeah, fits you two perfectly.

units.rawText: Ehehe... I knew it'd be nicer to hear it from the source than as a divination result!

units.rawText: Thank you, Professor! And you too, Hubble!
units.displayText: Thank you, Professor! And you too, Hubble!

spans.text: Thank you, Professor! And you too, Hubble!

units.displayText: Hehe, looks like Luna's already moved past her doubts...

spans.text: Watching as Luna takes her leave, humming a tune to herself, Hubble cannot help but smile.

units.rawText: Confidence on her face suits her far better.
units.displayText: Confidence on her face suits her far better.

spans.text: Confidence on her face suits her far better.

units.rawText: ...Thoughtful as always, Professor.
units.displayText: ...Thoughtful as always, Professor.

units.rawText: You say that, but to me it's more than perfect... I apologize for any inconvenience caused by asking you to prepare it in advance.
